name: GitHub
description: GitHub's own hosted MCP server: repositories, issues, pull requests, code search and Actions runs, with a fine-grained personal access token.
notes: Uses a fine-grained personal access token, kept in your system keychain. Give it only the repositories and permissions you need.
Read only unless you choose otherwise. Requests and the data you choose go to GitHub under its terms.
